findings_qualitative.value: Dense warm walls around the SMA1 wide-angle outflow seen in C34S and CCH

evidence.quote: We detected warm and dense walls around this wide-angle molecular outflow.

claims.hypothesis: Do C34S/CCH filaments trace outflow cavity walls?
claims.experiment: Compare C34S, CCH with CO and SiO maps
claims.result: C34S surrounds the red lobe; SiO at the interface
claims.finding: Walls of dense warm gas around the SMA1 wide-angle outflow, thickness ~1000-2000 AU

evidence.quote: Apparently this emission originates in the dense walls of the outflow cavity.

claims.hypothesis: Is SMA2 driving a separate outflow, from a binary?
claims.experiment: CO and SiO channel maps, C34S PV
claims.result: Bent outflow with chain of knots 350-500 AU apart; Keplerian-like rotation
claims.finding: Possible formation of a binary of low/intermediate-mass stars

evidence.quote: In general, in SMA2 we may witness the formation of a binary system consisting of low or intermediate mass stars.

claims.hypothesis: Are SMM1 and SMM2 new cores prestellar?
claims.experiment: Continuum detection, no line emission or IR source

evidence.quote: They may represent low-mass prestellar cores according to the widely adopted classification

evidence.quote: Therefore we conclude that this alternative explanation can be rejected.
